floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. The 2 BR Type A total columns differ from the displayed suite and balcony sums. The selector retains the original printed totals. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 7 Nshama design renders and 1 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. 2 additional DLD images are from the dated project album mirrored by Continental Club. Selected photographs depict the structure under construction.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 4 and 7. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 3050 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 8 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. The 2 BR Type A total columns differ from the displayed suite and balcony sums. The selector retains the original printed totals.
